name: TRACY and SILENE Phase II benchmark
description: Evaluation of the TRACE thermal-hydraulics code against the TRACY and SILENE Phase II experimental benchmark cases to assess code prediction accuracy for reactor/civil-safety scenarios.
evaluation_method: RMSE / mean_absolute_error / bias (error metrics comparing simulated outputs to experimental measurements)
general_score_metric: RMSE (root-mean-square error) between simulated and experimental time series
reputation: Well-regarded within the thermal-hydraulics and reactor-safety modelling community as an experimental validation benchmark for TRACE and similar codes, though niche outside that field.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark based on a limited set of physical experiments; results depend strongly on input/boundary conditions and model fidelity, so comparisons should account for modelling assumptions.
